name: TenderNed
notes: Radar searches TenderNed public publication endpoints for relevant current notices. TenderNed also offers an authenticated real-time XML API (credentials currently waitlisted), RSS/TNS, and quarterly open JSON/Excel datasets.

name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily
notes: Scheduled Scout supports the TED Search API.

name: Contracts Finder
notes: Scheduled Scout supports OCDS procurement search.

name: Custom RSS / Atom feeds
notes: Add museum, heritage, architecture and funding feeds in data/scout-config.json.

name: SAM.gov
notes: Reserved for a later API-key connector.

name: Web research agent
notes: Future layer for following weak signals through funding, architects, council records and museum news.

name: Find a Tender
notes: Primary UK above-threshold procurement source. Radar targets museum, exhibition, AV, software and interactive notices.

name: Sell2Wales
notes: Excellent official index for museum-exhibition, AV, immersive and interpretation opportunities across UK buyers.

name: Public Contracts Scotland
notes: Monitored for museum, heritage, exhibition design/build, interpretation and AV opportunities.

name: eTenders Ireland
notes: Monitored for museum-exhibition services, visitor experiences, exhibition design and multimedia opportunities.

name: eTendersNI
notes: Monitored for National Museums NI, heritage, visitor experience, AV and exhibition-production opportunities.

name: eVergabe Online
notes: German federal procurement source for museum exhibition, media design and technical implementation tenders.

name: Museum Insider
notes: Secondary discovery source for museum projects and tender documents. Never treated as formal procurement authority without verification.

name: BOAMP
notes: French official procurement bulletin with open data and a public API. Strong candidate for automated museum, scenography, multimedia and AV searches.

name: SIMAP
notes: Swiss public procurement platform. Public search works without authentication and the platform documents JSON API access for publication search.

name: Doffin
notes: Norway's official public procurement database. Useful for museums, science centres, visitor attractions, AV and exhibition-production opportunities.

name: HILMA
notes: Finland's official public procurement notice service, including upcoming and ongoing tenders and market-dialogue notices.

name: USP Ausschreibungssuche
notes: Central Austrian public-sector tender search, free to use and updated daily across procurement sources.

name: PLACSP
notes: Spain's national public-sector procurement platform with tender search, market consultations and public documentation.

name: Udbud.dk
notes: Danish national procurement overview covering current tenders, expected purchases, prior notices and contract awards; updated daily.
